channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kwame Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kwame Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Kwame Brown
item.description:
“They weren't having a very good season. Maybe they would lose some money, I don't know. So one of the first things we did was, with Chris, 'We can go two ways: We could give you players that add up to Pau's [salary] number, or if you prefer, we have a large expiring contract in Kwame Brown, right? And we can go that direction.'”

Mitch Kupchak on Kwame Brown, Mar 7, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Kwame Brown
item.description:
Christopher A. Vito:Brett Brown:

“If (Kwame Brown) can find a career-best fitness level, he still has value. A big man that can move as he moves, he has value.”

Brett Brown on Kwame Brown, Nov 20, 2013. Source: Twitter @ChrisVito.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Kwame Brown, Smush Parker
item.description:
Despite the number of seasons and NBA championships that have gone by, Bryant still bristles when he thinks of the 2005-06 season.

“I almost won an MVP with Smush Parker and Kwame Brown on my team,”

Kobe Bryant on Kwame Brown, Smush Parker, Oct 11, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Kwame Brown, Ekpe Udoh
item.description:
Mark Jackson on the trade:

“We are grown-ups and it hurts, so we are not going to sugarcoat it. We talked about it, we laughed, we cried and then we understood the mission was still the same, and it was a great win for us. I can't comment on anything officially right now but those three guys (Monta Ellis, Ekpe Udoh, Kwame Brown) bought into the system from Day 1. I owe a lot to them. People questioned me as a first-time coach, but those guys bought in since Day 1.”

Mark Jackson on Monta Ellis, Kwame Brown, Ekpe Udoh, Mar 14, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Michael Jordan, Kwame Brown
item.description:
The 6-foot-11, 270-pound Brown appeared in 48 games last season, averaging 3.3 points and 3.7 minutes in 13.8 minutes per game.

“He really wanted to take the challenge of playing again for Michael and playing for a top coach like Larry Brown,”

Mark Bartelstein on Michael Jordan, Kwame Brown, Aug 23, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
